items.text: Among patients in the hospital's difficult airway database who later needed airway management in the hospital, did documented recognition of known difficulty before airway management change after the March 2023 alert system, compared with the pre-existing trend?
items.population: Patients registered in the difficult airway database with a later airway management episode in the hospital, 2019 to 2026
items.intervention: Airway management after 1 March 2023 (alert system in place)
items.comparator: Airway management before 1 March 2023, with the pre-existing trend
items.outcome: Known difficulty documented as recognised before airway management

finer: Feasible with approved access and trainee time; interesting to the airway committee; novel locally; ethical as a service evaluation of records; relevant because near misses continue.
summary: One PECO question for a segmented before-after comparison.
